topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can’t believe what happened! Your car got towed right from your driveway? Like, how does that even happen? It’s like someone’s playing a cruel joke on you. I mean, who tows a car from a driveway? That’s some next-level chaos. You’ve got to tell me everything that led up to this. Was there a sign we missed? Did someone park in the wrong spot or something? We need to get this sorted out, stat. You deserve to have your car back where it belongs—right in front of your house. Let’s figure out the next move, okay? I’m here for you, just let me know what you need.
